overview: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster, cheaper model for complex search queries and agentic workflows.
OpenAI’s Codex boosts productivity for companies like Gondola and Holiday Extras, showing growing enterprise adoption.
Hugging Face releases fine‑tuning guide for 3D model TRELLIS.2, enabling task‑specific 3D generation.

top.title: Gondola doubles revenue as its team builds more with Codex
top.summary: Gondola uses OpenAI Codex to increase its lead engineer’s output by 50%, helping creatives gain credit and hire, while ChatGPT streamlines daily tasks, illustrating Codex’s impact on productivity.

top.title: Holiday Extras is rethinking what it can build with Codex
top.summary: Holiday Extras leverages Codex to transform customer expertise into improved apps, higher booking conversion rates, and new growth opportunities, highlighting AI’s role in enhancing travel services.

top.title: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions
top.summary: Google introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen, claiming superior handling of multi‑part, typo‑laden, and specific queries with richer visual answers, now default in AI Mode across its services.

top.title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
top.summary: Google’s Gemini 4 Hydrogen model improves Search by answering complex questions faster, offering better intent detection, visual results, and multi‑step task execution, positioned as a cost‑effective alternative to larger models.

top.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
top.summary: Google DeepMind details Gemini 4 Hydrogen’s speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows, priced flat per token and integrated with Orchestrator for multi‑model pipelines.

top.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
top.summary: Hugging Face provides scripts and LoRA‑based fine‑tuning for TRELLIS.2 3D generation, enabling developers to adapt the model to specific object categories with reduced compute overhead.
